 Century-old mosque near Indian PM’s residence under gov’t threat
 India’s Muslims fear the demolition of a century-old mosque near PM Narendra Modi’s residence after the imam claimed he received an eviction notice. There has been a wider demolition drive in the area, and the mosque’s water and electricity have been cut off.
